provenance.transport: Admin bodies: real HTTP. Core's public/index.php runs under PHP's own web server on 127.0.0.1 and every call is a POST encoded as the Webadmin's lib/core.ts encodes it - application/x-www-form-urlencoded;charset=UTF-8 with every value a string (boolean "1"/"0", number its decimal string, object one JSON string), multipart/form-data for a flyer upload - so PHP's own body parsing, $_POST, $_FILES and the Router serve it (tests/support/event_intake_http.php). No Admin route is handed a PHP int, bool or array. Member bodies: in-process Router dispatch, as the P1 member corpus.
provenance.provider_boundary: No socket is opened. AI answers are the recorded genuine provider answers of tests/fixtures/dates_event_ai (a link and a typed line: served only for the exact recorded request; a flyer, and the cases marked "fixed" in the generator: the recorded answer handed back by a provider double, because a re-encoded flyer is no longer the recorded request). Vision and Places are the genuine (Places: reduced) answers of tests/fixtures/dates_event_google. The page fetch returns the committed self-made pages.
provenance.pipeline_clock: The pipeline runs on the day the provider answers were recorded (2026-10-02T08:00:00Z); their dates are judged against it. After each genuine create call the intake's created_at, updated_at and next attempt are aligned to that clock (one second apart, in creation order, within the hour before it). Values derived from it are served as they are.

normalized_clock_fields.server_now: verified between actual dispatch start and end, then replaced
normalized_clock_fields.created_at/updated_at/at/checked_at/reso: replaced when the value is a wall-clock value of this capture; left as served when the pipeline clock produced it
normalized_clock_fields.lease.until, images_delete_after, retent: replaced by the constant plus their fixed offset when derived from a wall-clock value
normalized_clock_fields.event start_at/end_at/next_reverify_at i: exact stored equality, then shifted from the capture epoch; local times recomputed in the same zone

provenance.normalized_identifier_fields: intake, event, activity, audit, thread and source identifiers are mapped to stable ones in first-seen order
provenance.normalized_image_fields: image-read: digest, dimensions and absence of EXIF verified against the stored JPEG, then the base64 and the digest replaced; a stored image's byte size replaced (it depends on the encoder build)
provenance.not_in_the_corpus: Statuses no P2a code can produce are not fabricated: member_confirming and merged have no writer; withdrawn is written only by account erasure of a member-channel intake, and no P2a route creates one. See "coverage" for every closed value without a body.
